decisive_items: Papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores that are lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium
Shows mucin-containing goblet cells. Neither cytologic atypia nor atypical mitotic figures are present
exophytic, verrucous, skin-colored plaque on the right nasal vestibule
response.rationale: Exophytic papillary fronds with fibrovascular cores, goblet cells, and absent atypia are diagnostic of squamous papilloma; inverted papilloma would require inverted endophytic growth, and verrucous carcinoma would show atypia or invasion.

rejected.why: No inverted/endophytic growth pattern is described; the papillary fronds with fibrovascular cores favor exophytic squamous papilloma.
The verrucous clinical appearance is nonspecific, and the explicit absence of cytologic atypia and atypical mitotic figures argues against verrucous carcinoma.
